Your Privacy Rights

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and other applicable privacy laws, you have the right to opt-out of the sale or sharing of your personal information.

What We Do

We respect your privacy choices. We do not sell your personal information in the traditional sense. However, we may share certain information with third-party service providers who help us operate our website and provide services to you.

These third-party services may include:

Analytics providers (e.g., PostHog) - to understand how visitors use our website

Customer support services (e.g., Amazon Connect) - to provide customer assistance

  • Cloud infrastructure providers - to host and deliver our services

How to Opt-Out

You can opt-out of non-essential data sharing by:

Opt-Out of Data Sharing

Click the button below to opt-out of all non-essential data sharing. This will open your cookie preferences where you can reject analytics and marketing cookies.

You can also opt-out by:

Using our Cookie Settings to manage your cookie preferences

Disabling analytics cookies in your browser settings

Contacting us directly at the email address provided in our Privacy Policy

Additional Information

For more information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal information, please review our Privacy Policy.

Questions?

If you have questions about your privacy rights or this opt-out process, please contact us through the methods provided in our Privacy Policy.
